key_insight: The Homomorphic Advantage Operator stabilizes deep reinforcement learning under fully homomorphic encryption by zero-centering TD targets to prevent Bellman drift without adding nonlinear depth.
engineering_relevance: This enables privacy-preserving RL on encrypted cloud compute while preserving action rankings and avoiding expensive bootstrapping in CKKS-style deployments.
method: Apply a linear zero-mean centering projection to temporal-difference targets.
Remove the uniform state-value baseline that amplifies recursive approximation error.
Keep the operator homomorphic-friendly with no extra nonlinear multiplicative depth.
evidence_signal: Across a tabular MDP, encrypted CKKS CartPole, and a 20-node logistics benchmark, HAO achieved 0% boundary breaches across seeds and improved tabular policy accuracy by 18.0 percentage points.
watch_item: Performance depends on keeping activations within the polynomial approximation range, so ciphertext noise growth and implementation-specific CKKS precision remain important constraints.
paper_title: Homomorphic Advantage Operator: Stabilizing Reinforcement Learning Under Fully Homomorphic Encryption Constraints
